topics: Number: fractions, decimals, percentages, ratio, proportion, standard form
Algebra: linear equations, graphs, sequences, simultaneous equations (basic)
Geometry: angles, area, volume, Pythagoras, basic trigonometry (SOH CAH TOA)
Statistics: mean, median, mode, range, cumulative frequency, box plots
Probability: basic probability, tree diagrams, Venn diagrams

additionalTopics: Algebra: quadratic equations, completing the square, functions, surds
Geometry: circle theorems, vectors, exact trigonometric values
Statistics: histograms with unequal class widths, conditional probability
Calculus: rate of change from gradients (basic)

examStructure: Three papers: Paper 1 (non-calculator), Paper 2 (calculator), Paper 3 (calculator). Each 1h30m.
